name: Rubescent-Vortex

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past acid rain regions, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
